raw:
Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 4
Reason for Mistake: The Planner misinterpreted the song credits by treating “composer” as distinct from “songwriter” and assuming Brian Green was the composer instead of recognizing Miley Cyrus as a credited writer/composer. It then incorrectly conflated the credited Brian Green (producer/songwriter) with the actor Brian Austin Green, leading toward the wrong father (George Green). This misidentification would directly produce an incorrect answer rather than the correct father, Billy Ray Cyrus.
